title: 十年数据养一模型：群核科技反哺行业，电影与机器人训练谁先受益？
speaker: Victor Huang

segments.en: Our original software is generate a lot of data for our new AI model.
segments.zh: 我们的原有软件为新的AI模型生成了大量数据。

segments.en: So, this model is based on the training data that will be accumulated more than a decade ago.
segments.zh: 这个模型基于十多年前积累的训练数据。

segments.en: This kind of data can generate a space.
segments.zh: 这类数据可以生成空间。

segments.en: This space can also benefit many different domain so like filming a robotic training.
segments.zh: 这个空间还能惠及许多不同领域，比如电影制作、机器人训练。

segments.en: So, everything is start from data then going to model then going to agent.
segments.zh: 一切从数据开始，再到模型，再到智能体。

segments.en: So, now the agent can benefit many different domain so we hope so we can benefit more and more domain.
segments.zh: 现在智能体可以惠及许多不同领域，我们希望惠及更多领域。

segments.en: But, everything is speaking with our original product.
segments.zh: 但一切都源于我们的原有产品。
